After Legal archived C-37 it left Your Contracts and R-16 showed the original ask with an archived notice and no Documents or comments.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The work lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. This walkthrough created only records named DOC-029 roles ... and changed no organisation settings. It restored teams, owners, Grants and Region after each check.

The conversion of existing Contributor accounts to Business Users, the removal of the Stakeholder list and the preservation of Confidential audiences at upgrade were not replayed; the seeded lab has no pre-upgrade data. They rest on source inspection in technical-review.json.

Some Legal set-up actions used API stand-ins, named in each step: fixture comments at the older Working Team tier (the UI no longer offers it), archiving and restoring C-37, and the fixture records in setup-r1.mjs.
Notification delivery after removal was not checked; removal was checked through the record link, the Documents read and the Comments read.
Round 1 failed on the comment tier labels and on a Portal History sentence (walkthrough-r1.json). Round 2 ran the whole article again against the corrected text.
